objective: Deliver read-only commerce market census for Agent402/x402 and the402, with normalized datasets, analysis, and evidence-backed opportunity recommendations.
summary: the402 is paused since 2026-08-02 with 0 open requests and no live payments; 485 catalog services exist but no buyer demand is accessible now. requested_action: Review the opportunity shortlist, confirm first product to build, and prepare product spec under products/drafts/. Do not create listings or spend funds.
